name: skeleton-group
title: Skeleton group
description: Wraps skeleton placeholders so they read as one Loading to screen readers and sweep as one wave, with no delays wired by hand.
docs: Put Skeleton blocks inside, at any depth: the group staggers their shimmer in document order, marks the region aria-busy and renders one visually hidden status instead of a dozen silent boxes. When loading turns false the placeholders are not rendered and nothing is announced. A custom shape joins the wave with data-skeleton, or asks for a delay with useSkeletonDelay(index).
